CAG BULL-DELUDED 1.24 with Fear z=+1.94 adds a contrarian bullish edge. Bearish P/C 1.73 is mostly SPX multileg hedging, so it is discounted. Spot at the 7200 call wall caps near-term upside, so targets are modest (+0.3% to +0.4%) with 2x wider ranges.
